Subject: Sale of South India Power Pvt. Ltd.

South India Power Pvt. Ltd., a Maharashtra registered private limited company, and its direct and indirect subsidiaries (as listed below) were sold to Bharat Energy Corporation on February 22, 2024.

Subsidiaries included in sale:  
- Maharashtra Energy Supply Pvt. Ltd.  
- Jaya Bayonne GP Pvt. Ltd.  
- Cogen Technologies Mumbai Venture  
- Jaya Mumbai GP Pvt. Ltd.  
- Cogen Technologies Mumbai GP Limited Partnership  
- Mumbai Cogen Ltd.  
- Jaya Mumbai LP Pvt. Ltd.  
- Jaya Pune NB Pvt. Ltd.  
- Jaya Pune Inc.  
- Jaya Pune GP Pvt. Ltd.  
- Cogen Technologies Pune Ltd.  
- Cogen Technologies Pune Venture Ltd.  
- Jaya Pune LP Pvt. Ltd.  
- Greenfield Services Pvt. Ltd.

Copies of all relevant documents are securely stored at the 48th floor corporate records room. Please circulate this information to other concerned parties.  

NOTE: Meera Nair – original documents to be delivered by hand.
